'''Redldr12 LS hoth scenario (MISC)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Redldr12]]
* '''Published:''' 21 July 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Hoth Main Power Generators (1st LShothsc.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the Light side deck that I used at a recent Hoth scenario torny.  I didn't fare very well and I'd like sugestions on how to improve my deck.  In the hoth scenario only hoth locations may be used with the ecption of one othe systemof parsec 2-6. Light side starts with the Main power generators and on oher location and Dark side starts with The north ridge and one other location.

== Strategy ==

THE FIRST TURN GET OUT THE WAR ROOM AND AND ECHO BASE GARISON WITH YOUR STARTING EFFECT.  TRY TO BUILD UP ON HOTH WITH TROOPERS AND SPEEDERS.  PUT LEIA AND INCOM CORP. AT THE WAR ROOM TO SLOW DARK SIDE DRAINS.  BUT BEWARE OF COLAPSING CORRIDOR.  EARN AS MANY SCENARIO POINT AS POSSIBLE.  HAVE FUN AND GIVE ME YOUR IMPUT.  SEE THE ENTIRE SCENARIO RULES AT www.theforce.net
